chapterInfo.content:
12
1Na kae wo Bɔfoɔ wo mmeranteberɛ mu ansa na nna bɔne no aba, na mfeɛ a wobɛka sɛ: Menni ho anigyeɛ, no adu; 2ansa na owia ne hann ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma aduru sum, na osuo nya tɔ a, asane amuna, 3ɛda a efie awɛmfoɔ ho bɛpopoɔ, na mmarima ahoɔdenfoɔ no mu akonton, na ayuyamfoɔ agyaeɛ, sɛ wɔasua nti, na wɔn a wɔhwɛ mpomma mu ani so ayɛ wɔn kusuu; 4na wɔatoto borɔno so apono mu, na ayuyameeɛ gyegyeegye ano abrɛ ase, na wasɔre anomaa su ano, na nnwontofoɔ nyinaa nne asi ase. 5Nso wɔasuro deɛ ɛkorɔn, na ehu aba kwan mu, na sorɔno bɛgu nhyerɛne, na abɛbɛ ayɛ adesoa, na akɔnnɔ to atwa, ɛfiri sɛ onipa rekɔ ne daa fie, na ayiyɛfoɔ rekyini mmorɔno so; 6ansa na dwetɛ homa no ate, na sika toa no apae, na ahina no abɔ asuo ho, na asubura ho nkyimiiɛ abubu, 7#Skf 3.20; Gye 3.19 na dɔteɛ asane akɔ asase mu sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ kane no, na honhom asane akɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔde maeɛ no nkyɛn.
8 # Skf 1.2 Ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ, Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no na ɔseɛ, ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ.
Asɛm no awieeɛ ne Nyankopɔn suro
9 # 1 Ah 4.32 Nanso deɛ ɛka ho a Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no yɛ mu nyansafoɔ no, ɔkyerɛɛ ɔman no nimdeɛ kaa ho, na ɔkarii na ɔpeepee mu, na ɔbubuu mmɛ bebree. 10Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛhunu nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ, na deɛ wɔatwerɛ no ne tenenee ne nokorɛ nsɛm.
11 # Heb 4.12 Anyansafoɔ nsɛm te sɛ anantwikafoɔ mpea ne nnadewa a nhyiam mu akunini de ama a ɔhwɛfoɔ baako na ɔde maeɛ. 12Na deɛ aka yeinom akyire no nso, me ba, fa to w’adwene mu. Nwoma bebree yɛ nni awieeɛ, na adesua dodoɔ pii mu wɔ ɔhaw.
13 # 1 Ti 1.5 Asɛm no awieeɛ, deɛ yɛateɛ nyinaa ne sɛ: Suro Onyankopɔn, na di ne mmara nsɛm so. Na yei ne nnipa nyinaa asɛdeɛ. 14#Rom 2.16; 1 Ko 4.5 Na nneyɛɛ nyinaa na Onyankopɔn de bɛba atemmuo mu, na deɛ ahunta nyinaa nso, papa oo, bɔne oo, wabu ho atɛn.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na kae wo Bɔfoɔ wo mmeranteberɛ mu ansa na nna bɔne no aba, na mfeɛ a wobɛka sɛ: Menni ho anigyeɛ, no adu; ansa na owia ne hann ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma aduru sum, na osuo nya tɔ a, asane amuna, ɛda a efie awɛmfoɔ ho bɛpopoɔ, na mmarima ahoɔdenfoɔ no mu akonton, na ayuyamfoɔ agyaeɛ, sɛ wɔasua nti, na wɔn a wɔhwɛ mpomma mu ani so ayɛ wɔn kusuu; na wɔatoto borɔno so apono mu, na ayuyameeɛ gyegyeegye ano abrɛ ase, na wasɔre anomaa su ano, na nnwontofoɔ nyinaa nne asi ase. Nso wɔasuro deɛ ɛkorɔn, na ehu aba kwan mu, na sorɔno bɛgu nhyerɛne, na abɛbɛ ayɛ adesoa, na akɔnnɔ to atwa, ɛfiri sɛ onipa rekɔ ne daa fie, na ayiyɛfoɔ rekyini mmorɔno so; ansa na dwetɛ homa no ate, na sika toa no apae, na ahina no abɔ asuo ho, na asubura ho nkyimiiɛ abubu, na dɔteɛ asane akɔ asase mu sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ kane no, na honhom asane akɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔde maeɛ no nkyɛn.
Ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ, Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no na ɔseɛ, ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ.

Nanso deɛ ɛka ho a Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no yɛ mu nyansafoɔ no, ɔkyerɛɛ ɔman no nimdeɛ kaa ho, na ɔkarii na ɔpeepee mu, na ɔbubuu mmɛ bebree. Ɔsɛnkafoɔ no hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛhunu nsɛm a ɛyɛ dɛ, na deɛ wɔatwerɛ no ne tenenee ne nokorɛ nsɛm.
Anyansafoɔ nsɛm te sɛ anantwikafoɔ mpea ne nnadewa a nhyiam mu akunini de ama a ɔhwɛfoɔ baako na ɔde maeɛ. Na deɛ aka yeinom akyire no nso, me ba, fa to w’adwene mu. Nwoma bebree yɛ nni awieeɛ, na adesua dodoɔ pii mu wɔ ɔhaw.
Asɛm no awieeɛ, deɛ yɛateɛ nyinaa ne sɛ: Suro Onyankopɔn, na di ne mmara nsɛm so. Na yei ne nnipa nyinaa asɛdeɛ. Na nneyɛɛ nyinaa na Onyankopɔn de bɛba atemmuo mu, na deɛ ahunta nyinaa nso, papa oo, bɔne oo, wabu ho atɛn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
